host: European Innovation Council (EIC) under Horizon Europe
summary: The EIC Accelerator Open 2025 supports single start-ups and SMEs developing breakthrough market-creating innovations beyond proof-of-concept (TRL≥5) for demonstration, market validation, and scale-up (up to TRL 8). It offers a blended financial package including grants up to €2.5 million and equity investments up to €15 million via the EIC Fund. The funding aims to accelerate the development and commercial deployment of innovative technologies in any field. Applicants undergo a three-step selection process: short proposal, full proposal, and face-to-face interview with the EIC Jury. The total budget for the open call is €384 million.
eligible_applicants: Single for-profit legal entities established in EU Member States or Horizon Europe Associated Countries
SMEs including small mid-caps (up to 500 employees) (only for investment component)
Individuals intending to establish a start-up or SME
activity_types: Subcontracting work essential to the project
reporting_requirements: Submission of short proposal including overview and pitch materials
Submission of full proposal upon invitation
Participation in face-to-face interview with EIC Jury
Compliance with Horizon Europe reporting standards as per grant agreement
